description: Search USPTO maintenance-fee events across patents by event code, patent-number prefix, and/or event-date range — e.g. all 'EXP.' (expired for non-payment) events in a date window. Returns an exact total_matching count first, then a capped sample of the actual event rows (newest first) — never a bare empty array on zero matches; the filters tried are always echoed back. Sourced from USPTO's Patent Maintenance Fee Events (public domain); every response carries data_as_of. Keyless.

date_from.description: Event date lower bound, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Event date upper bound, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD.

event_code.description: Exact USPTO event code, e.g. "EXP." (expired, non-payment), "EXPX" (reinstated), "M1551" (4th-year large-entity payment).

limit.description: Max sample rows to return (default 50, max 200).

patent_number_prefix.description: Patent-number prefix, e.g. "10835" or "RE4". Digits only unless a reissue "RE" prefix.

name: search_maintenance_fee_events
